description: For each of PlainQuant's library stock-picking rules (US and Hong Kong) at default settings: the plain backtest's return a year after trading costs beside the honest estimate left after delisted stocks and untuned test periods (fractions: 0.05 = 5% a year), market_return_a_year (the market's own return over the same window), the trade count, won_share, best10_share_of_profit and the test window; on_site false marks a rule the site's pages leave out (a negative estimate). famous_rules: the famous rules (golden cross, 200-day average, 52-week high and others) at their pages' settings, and the death cross and May-to-October studies. Use for 'does momentum / value / moving-average investing work' or 'how much do backtests overstate'.
name: rule_estimates
title: How library stock-picking rules really did
